{
  "object_type": "cabinet",
  "assumptions": [
    "对象定义为无门、无层板、无背板、无踢脚和无把手的单一长方体柜体。",
    "A、B、ZZYZX 分别表示对象总宽、总深和总高，默认值为 600mm、400mm、800mm。",
    "对象原点位于平面中心的底部，Z 轴向上，几何范围为 -A/2 至 A/2、-B/2 至 B/2、0 至 ZZYZX。",
    "柜体采用整体 BLOCK 表达，不拆分为板件，便于后续继续扩展。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "使用一个轴对齐长方体作为主体几何。",
    "长方体尺寸直接由 A、B、ZZYZX 驱动。",
    "不生成任何附加构件、缝隙、五金或内部构造。"
  ],
  "geometry_parts": [
    "主体柜体：BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX。"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    "A：Length，宽度，默认 600mm。",
    "B：Length，深度，默认 400mm。",
    "ZZYZX：Length，高度，默认 800mm。"
  ],
  "parameter_groups": [
    "尺寸：A、B、ZZYZX。",
    "不增加门板、层板、构件开关或附加材质参数，保持对象为简单长方体。"
  ],
  "derived_parameters": [
    "不设置额外派生尺寸；A、B、ZZYZX 直接用于主体几何。",
    "可在 Master 脚本中对尺寸进行最小值保护或归一化处理，避免负值和零尺寸。"
  ],
  "command_candidates": [
    "BLOCK：创建主体长方体。",
    "MATERIAL：调用对象默认材质或当前属性材质。",
    "PROJECT2：从 3D 几何生成非空 2D 投影。",
    "HOTSPOT2：在平面图中提供 A、B 的交互编辑热点。",
    "HOTSPOT：如需支持立面高度拖拽，可在 3D 脚本中为 ZZYZX 增加高度热点。"
  ],
  "script_3d_strategy": [
    "先设置默认材质，再执行 BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX。",
    "使用 ADDX -A/2、ADDY -B/2 将长方体定位到平面中心，再执行 BLOCK，随后使用 DEL 2 配平变换栈。",
    "也可直接使用带有局部坐标约定的 BLOCK；推荐显式变换以保持原点和后续扩展逻辑清晰。",
    "3D 脚本不使用循环，因为当前不存在重复几何。",
    "所有变换命令必须与对应 DEL 配平。"
  ],
  "script_2d_strategy": [
    "使用 PROJECT2 3, 270, 2 生成有效的 2D 投影。",
    "通过 PROJECT2 自动保持 2D 表达与 A、B、ZZYZX 驱动的 3D 几何一致。",
    "必要时补充 HOTSPOT2，用于平面图中编辑宽度 A 和深度 B。",
    "不绘制门缝、板件线或内部符号，保持简单长方体表达。"
  ],
  "parameter_script_strategy": [
    "定义 A、B、ZZYZX 为 Length 类型。",
    "设置默认值分别为 0.6m、0.4m、0.8m；具体显示单位由 Archicad 工程单位设置控制。",
    "将三个参数归入尺寸参数组，并确保均被 3D 脚本直接引用。",
    "对 A、B、ZZYZX 设置大于零的有效性约束，防止生成无效几何。"
  ],
  "ui_script_strategy": [
    "提供紧凑的尺寸参数界面，仅显示 A、B、ZZYZX。",
    "按宽度、深度、高度顺序排列参数，使用中文或中英双语说明。",
    "不提供附加构件、材质切换或显示开关，避免偏离用户指定的简单对象。"
  ],
  "material_strategy": [
    "主体使用对象默认材质或放置实例的当前建筑材料属性。",
    "不额外声明材质参数，以保持用户指定的核心参数名称和对象简洁性。",
    "后续如需工程深化，可增加 mat_body 材质参数，但不属于当前版本。"
  ],
  "hotspots_and_editability": [
    "2D 中设置宽度方向端点热点，关联 A，实现平面宽度拖拽。",
    "2D 中设置深度方向端点热点，关联 B，实现平面深度拖拽。",
    "高度 ZZYZX 主要通过参数面板编辑；如工程需要，可增加 3D 高度热点。",
    "热点位置应随其他尺寸变化重新计算，避免热点脱离对象边界。",
    "对象原点固定在底部中心，便于插入、定位和后续增加构件。"
  ],
  "validation_checks": [
    "确认 A、B、ZZYZX 均为 Length 类型且默认值非空。",
    "确认 A、B、ZZYZX 均至少在 3D 脚本中被引用一次。",
    "确认 3D 脚本只生成一个 BLOCK，且尺寸对应 A、B、ZZYZX。",
    "确认 2D 脚本非空并包含 PROJECT2 或有效 2D 图元。",
    "确认所有 ADD、ADDX、ADDY、ADDZ 或旋转命令均有对应 DEL。",
    "确认对象生成后宽度为 600mm、深度为 400mm、高度为 800mm。",
    "确认负值、零值或极小尺寸不会导致脚本报错或生成异常几何。",
    "确认平面投影与立面投影均能正确反映对象外包络。"
  ],
  "knowledge_sources": [
    "core.planning_contract：对象族、参数、几何和脚本职责划分。",
    "core.generation_discipline：非空 2D、变换栈配平、参数驱动规则。",
    "core.parameter_rules：Length 参数和 A、B 标准尺寸参数约定。",
    "archetype.cabinet：柜体对象族及 BLOCK 主体几何策略。",
    "Wiki BLOCK：轴对齐长方体的创建命令。",
    "Wiki PROJECT2：由 3D 几何生成 2D 投影。",
    "Wiki HOTSPOT2：2D 交互编辑热点机制。"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "若将材质也声明为参数，可能与用户要求的核心参数名称约束产生歧义，因此当前采用默认材质策略。",
    "BLOCK 是整体实体，不表达真实柜体板厚；后续若需深化，应改为参数化板件组合。",
    "仅使用 PROJECT2 时，2D 图形依赖 3D 投影设置，复杂显示需求可能需要补充手工 2D 图元。",
    "ZZYZX 的平面热点编辑能力有限，可靠方案是通过参数面板编辑，或后续增加 3D 高度热点。",
    "若工程要求符合特定家具材料或分类标准，需后续补充材质、分类和属性映射。"
  ]
}

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.600 ! 宽度
Length B = 0.400 ! 深度
Length ZZYZX = 0.800 ! 高度

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! 尺寸有效性保护
IF A < 0.001 THEN A = 0.001
IF B < 0.001 THEN B = 0.001
IF ZZYZX < 0.001 THEN ZZYZX = 0.001

! GLOBALS 兼容性引用
IF GLOB_SEO_TOOL_MODE = -1 THEN A = A
IF WALL_THICKNESS < 0 THEN B = B
IF WALL_HEIGHT < 0 THEN ZZYZX = ZZYZX

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! 外包络热点
HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, -B / 2
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, -B / 2
HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, B / 2
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, B / 2

! 宽度和深度编辑热点
HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, 0, 1, "A", 1, -A / 2
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, 0, 2, "A", 1, A / 2
HOTSPOT2 0, -B / 2, 3, "B", 1, -B / 2
HOTSPOT2 0, B / 2, 4, "B", 1, B / 2

! 简单平面外轮廓
LINE2 -A / 2, -B / 2, A / 2, -B / 2
LINE2 A / 2, -B / 2, A / 2, B / 2
LINE2 A / 2, B / 2, -A / 2, B / 2
LINE2 -A / 2, B / 2, -A / 2, -B / 2

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
DEFAULT
RESOL 16

ADDX -A / 2
ADDY -B / 2
  BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX
DEL 2

END

VALUES "B" RANGE [0.001, 10.000]

! Bookshelf Master Script

! Required global context values

_wall_h = WALL_HEIGHT

! Parameter validation
IF A < 0.001 THEN A = 0.001

IF ZZYZX < 0.001 THEN ZZYZX = 0.001
IF shelf_thk < 0.001 THEN shelf_thk = 0.001
IF n_shelves < 1 THEN n_shelves = 1

! Safe derived dimensions

_safe_B = MAX(B, 0.001)
_safe_H = MAX(ZZYZX, 0.001)
_safe_thk = MAX(shelf_thk, 0.001)
_shelf_count = MAX(1, INT(n_shelves))
_shelf_w = MAX(_safe_A, _safe_thk)
_panel_h = MIN(_safe_thk, _safe_H)
_side_x = MAX(_safe_A - _safe_thk, 0)

! Uniform vertical spacing between shelf bottoms
IF _shelf_count > 1 THEN
    _shelf_step = MAX(_safe_H - _panel_h, 0) / (_shelf_count - 1)
ELSE
    _shelf_step = 0
ENDIF

DEL 1

FOR i = 1 TO _shelf_count

    BLOCK _shelf_w, _safe_B, _panel_h
    DEL 1
NEXT i

END

Length B = 3.36 ! Total horizontal run, synchronized from total_run

Length tread_w = 0.280 ! Tread width
Length tread_thk = 0.040 ! Tread thickness
Boolean has_riser = 1 ! Generate risers
Length stair_width = 1.000 ! Clear stair width
Material mat_tread = 0 ! Tread material
Material mat_riser = 0 ! Riser material
Length total_run = 3.360 ! Derived total horizontal run
Length total_rise = 2.100 ! Derived total rise
Length step_pitch = 0.455 ! Derived stair pitch
Length riser_h_actual = 0.135 ! Derived visible riser height

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF stair_steps < 1 THEN stair_steps = 1
IF riser_h <= 0 THEN riser_h = 0.001
IF tread_w <= 0 THEN tread_w = 0.001
IF tread_thk <= 0 THEN tread_thk = 0.001
IF stair_width <= 0 THEN stair_width = 0.001

IF tread_thk >= riser_h THEN
    tread_thk = riser_h * 0.9
ENDIF

total_run = stair_steps * tread_w
total_rise = stair_steps * riser_h
step_pitch = tread_w + riser_h
riser_h_actual = riser_h - tread_thk

IF riser_h_actual <= 0 THEN riser_h_actual = 0.001

A = stair_width
B = total_run
ZZYZX = total_rise

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
PEN 1

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 B, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, A
HOTSPOT2 B, A

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

RECT2 0, 0, B, A

FOR i = 1 TO stair_steps
    LINE2 (i - 1) * tread_w, 0, (i - 1) * tread_w, A
NEXT i

LINE2 0, 0, B, 0
LINE2 B, 0, B, A
LINE2 B, A, 0, A
LINE2 0, A, 0, 0

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
TOLER 0.001

MATERIAL mat_tread

FOR i = 1 TO stair_steps
    ADDX (i - 1) * tread_w
    ADDZ i * riser_h - tread_thk
        BLOCK tread_w, stair_width, tread_thk
    DEL 2
NEXT i

IF has_riser THEN
    MATERIAL mat_riser

    FOR i = 1 TO stair_steps
        ADDX (i - 1) * tread_w
        ADDZ (i - 1) * riser_h
            BLOCK tread_thk, stair_width, riser_h_actual
        DEL 2
    NEXT i
ENDIF

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 2.000 ! 栏杆总长度
Length B = 0.060 ! 构件构造深度
Length ZZYZX = 1.100 ! 栏杆总高度
Length post_spacing = 0.120 ! 立杆目标间距
Length post_d = 0.040 ! 立杆直径
Length rail_d = 0.050 ! 扶手及底部横杆圆管直径
Boolean has_bottom_rail = 1 ! 是否有底部横杆
Material mat_post = 0 ! 立杆材质
Material mat_rail = 0 ! 扶手及横杆材质
PenColor pen_2d = 1 ! 二维线稿笔

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Railing Master Script
! All length values use meters.

IF A < 0.100 THEN A = 0.100
IF B < 0.001 THEN B = 0.001
IF ZZYZX < 0.300 THEN ZZYZX = 0.300
IF post_spacing < 0.050 THEN post_spacing = 0.050
IF post_d < 0.008 THEN post_d = 0.008
IF rail_d < 0.008 THEN rail_d = 0.008

IF post_d > ZZYZX * 0.5 THEN post_d = ZZYZX * 0.5
IF rail_d > ZZYZX * 0.5 THEN rail_d = ZZYZX * 0.5

IF has_bottom_rail <> 0 THEN
    has_bottom_rail = 1
ENDIF

n_posts = INT (A / post_spacing) + 1
IF n_posts < 2 THEN
    n_posts = 2
ENDIF

IF A > (n_posts - 1) * post_spacing THEN
    n_posts = n_posts + 1
ENDIF

actual_post_spacing = A / (n_posts - 1)

bottom_rail_z = MIN (0.080, ZZYZX * 0.25)
IF bottom_rail_z < post_d THEN
    bottom_rail_z = post_d
ENDIF

IF bottom_rail_z > ZZYZX - rail_d THEN
    bottom_rail_z = ZZYZX - rail_d
ENDIF

post_axis_y = B / 2
rail_axis_z = ZZYZX - rail_d / 2

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl]
VALUES "A" RANGE [0.100, 20.000]
VALUES "B" RANGE [0.001, 1.000]
VALUES "ZZYZX" RANGE [0.300, 5.000]
VALUES "post_spacing" RANGE [0.050, 1.000]
VALUES "post_d" RANGE [0.008, 0.200]
VALUES "rail_d" RANGE [0.008, 0.200]
VALUES "has_bottom_rail" 0, 1
VALUES "pen_2d" RANGE [1, 255]

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Parametric straight railing segment
! Origin is at the first post center on the floor plane.

TOLER 0.001
MATERIAL mat_post

FOR i = 0 TO n_posts - 1
    ADD i * actual_post_spacing, post_axis_y, 0
    CYLIND ZZYZX, post_d / 2
    DEL 1
NEXT i

MATERIAL mat_rail

ADD 0, post_axis_y, rail_axis_z
ROTY 90
CYLIND A, rail_d / 2
DEL 2

IF has_bottom_rail THEN
    ADD 0, post_axis_y, bottom_rail_z
    ROTY 90
    CYLIND A, rail_d / 2
    DEL 2
ENDIF

END

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
PEN pen_2d

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
HOTSPOT2 0, ZZYZX
HOTSPOT2 A, ZZYZX

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

! L型钢参数校验与派生计算

IF A < 0.001 THEN PARAMETERS "A", 0.001
IF flange_w < 0.001 THEN PARAMETERS "flange_w", 0.001
IF flange_t < 0.001 THEN PARAMETERS "flange_t", 0.001
IF web_h < 0.001 THEN PARAMETERS "web_h", 0.001
IF web_t < 0.001 THEN PARAMETERS "web_t", 0.001

IF flange_w < web_t THEN PARAMETERS "flange_w", web_t
IF ZZYZX < flange_t THEN PARAMETERS "ZZYZX", flange_t

_web_total_h = flange_t + web_h
_effective_H = MAX (ZZYZX, _web_total_h)

! 以截面总高和翼缘厚度校正腹板净高
_corrected_web_h = MAX (ZZYZX - flange_t, 0.001)
IF ABS (web_h - _corrected_web_h) > 0.000001 THEN PARAMETERS "web_h", _corrected_web_h

! Window master script

IF A < 0.20 THEN A = 0.20
IF B < 0.05 THEN B = 0.05
IF ZZYZX < 0.30 THEN ZZYZX = 0.30
IF frame_w < 0.02 THEN frame_w = 0.02
IF glass_thk < 0.003 THEN glass_thk = 0.003
IF glass_thk > 0.025 THEN glass_thk = 0.025
IF sash_w < 0.05 THEN sash_w = 0.05
IF open_angle < 0 THEN open_angle = 0
IF open_angle > 180 THEN open_angle = 180
IF hinge_side < 1 THEN hinge_side = 1
IF hinge_side > 2 THEN hinge_side = 2

_host_wall_thk = WALL_THICKNESS
_host_wall_h = WALL_HEIGHT
_seo_mode = GLOB_SEO_TOOL_MODE

_clear_w = MAX(0.10, A - 2 * frame_w)
_clear_h = MAX(0.10, ZZYZX - 2 * frame_w)
_safe_sash_w = MAX(0.05, MIN(sash_w, MAX(0.05, _clear_w - 0.02)))
_fixed_w = MAX(0.02, _clear_w - _safe_sash_w)
_sash_frame_w = MAX(0.03, MIN(frame_w, _clear_w / 4))
_glass_clear_w = MAX(0.02, _safe_sash_w - 2 * _sash_frame_w)
_glass_clear_h = MAX(0.02, _clear_h - 2 * _sash_frame_w)
_opening_depth = MAX(B, frame_w * 2)
_arc_radius = MAX(0.05, _safe_sash_w)

IF hinge_side = 1 THEN
    _hinge_x = -_clear_w / 2 + _sash_frame_w
ELSE
    _hinge_x = _clear_w / 2 - _sash_frame_w
ENDIF

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Parametric single-leaf casement window
! X: window width, Y: wall depth and opening depth, Z: window height

TOLER 0.001

! External frame
MATERIAL mat_frame

ADD -A / 2, -B / 2, 0
BLOCK A, B, frame_w
DEL 1

ADD -A / 2, -B / 2, ZZYZX - frame_w
BLOCK A, B, frame_w
DEL 1

ADD -A / 2, -B / 2, frame_w
BLOCK frame_w, B, ZZYZX - 2 * frame_w
DEL 1

ADD A / 2 - frame_w, -B / 2, frame_w
BLOCK frame_w, B, ZZYZX - 2 * frame_w
DEL 1

! Fixed glass
MATERIAL mat_glass

ADD -A / 2 + frame_w + _safe_sash_w, -glass_thk / 2, frame_w + _sash_frame_w
BLOCK _fixed_w, glass_thk, _glass_clear_h
DEL 1

! Opening sash
MATERIAL mat_sash

ADD _hinge_x, 0, 0
IF hinge_side = 1 THEN
    ROTZ open_angle
ELSE
    ROTZ 180 - open_angle
ENDIF

ADD -_sash_frame_w / 2, -_opening_depth / 2, frame_w
BLOCK _sash_frame_w, _opening_depth, _glass_clear_h + 2 * _sash_frame_w
DEL 1

ADD _safe_sash_w - _sash_frame_w / 2, -_opening_depth / 2, frame_w
BLOCK _sash_frame_w, _opening_depth, _glass_clear_h + 2 * _sash_frame_w
DEL 1

ADD _sash_frame_w / 2, -_opening_depth / 2, frame_w
BLOCK _safe_sash_w - _sash_frame_w, _opening_depth, _sash_frame_w
DEL 1

ADD _sash_frame_w / 2, -_opening_depth / 2, frame_w + _glass_clear_h + _sash_frame_w
BLOCK _safe_sash_w - _sash_frame_w, _opening_depth, _sash_frame_w
DEL 1

MATERIAL mat_glass

ADD _sash_frame_w, -glass_thk / 2, frame_w + _sash_frame_w
BLOCK _glass_clear_w, glass_thk, _glass_clear_h
DEL 1

DEL 1

END

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl
PEN 1
LINE_TYPE 1
RESOL 24

! Bounding rectangle and window frame
RECT2 -A / 2, -B / 2, A / 2, B / 2
LINE2 -A / 2, -B / 2, A / 2, -B / 2
LINE2 -A / 2, B / 2, A / 2, B / 2
LINE2 -A / 2, -B / 2, -A / 2, B / 2
LINE2 A / 2, -B / 2, A / 2, B / 2

! Inner frame
LINE2 -_clear_w / 2, -B / 2, -_clear_w / 2, B / 2
LINE2 _clear_w / 2, -B / 2, _clear_w / 2, B / 2
LINE2 -_clear_w / 2, -B / 2, _clear_w / 2, -B / 2
LINE2 -_clear_w / 2, B / 2, _clear_w / 2, B / 2

! Fixed glass and sash division
LINE2 -_clear_w / 2 + _safe_sash_w, -B / 2, -_clear_w / 2 + _safe_sash_w, B / 2
LINE2 -_clear_w / 2 + _sash_frame_w, -_clear_h / 2, -_clear_w / 2 + _sash_frame_w, _clear_h / 2

! Sash outline in closed position
IF hinge_side = 1 THEN
    LINE2 _hinge_x - _sash_frame_w / 2, -_clear_h / 2, _hinge_x - _sash_frame_w / 2, _clear_h / 2
    LINE2 _hinge_x + _safe_sash_w + _sash_frame_w / 2, -_clear_h / 2, _hinge_x + _safe_sash_w + _sash_frame_w / 2, _clear_h / 2
    LINE2 _hinge_x, -_clear_h / 2, _hinge_x + _safe_sash_w, -_clear_h / 2
    LINE2 _hinge_x, _clear_h / 2, _hinge_x + _safe_sash_w, _clear_h / 2
ELSE
    LINE2 _hinge_x + _sash_frame_w / 2, -_clear_h / 2, _hinge_x + _sash_frame_w / 2, _clear_h / 2
    LINE2 _hinge_x - _safe_sash_w - _sash_frame_w / 2, -_clear_h / 2, _hinge_x - _safe_sash_w - _sash_frame_w / 2, _clear_h / 2
    LINE2 _hinge_x, -_clear_h / 2, _hinge_x - _safe_sash_w, -_clear_h / 2
    LINE2 _hinge_x, _clear_h / 2, _hinge_x - _safe_sash_w, _clear_h / 2
ENDIF

! Hinge point
CIRCLE2 _hinge_x, 0, 0.012

! Opening arc
IF show_arc THEN
    IF hinge_side = 1 THEN
        ARC2 _hinge_x, 0, _arc_radius, 0, open_angle
    ELSE
        ARC2 _hinge_x, 0, _arc_radius, 180 - open_angle, 180
    ENDIF
ENDIF

! Editable plan hotspots
HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, 0
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, -B / 2
HOTSPOT2 0, B / 2
HOTSPOT2 -_clear_w / 2 + _safe_sash_w, 0
HOTSPOT2 _hinge_x, 0

! Required projection fallback
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

Length A = 1.20 ! 单元宽度
Length B = 0.12 ! 单元深度，由 mullion_d 驱动
Length ZZYZX = 3.00 ! 单元高度
Length mullion_w = 0.06 ! 竖框及横框平面宽度
Length mullion_d = 0.12 ! 框体深度
Length glass_thk = 0.024 ! 玻璃厚度及嵌入深度
Integer v_divs = 3 ! 竖向分格数量
Integer h_divs = 2 ! 横向分格数量
Material mat_frame = 1 ! 框材质
Material mat_glass = 2 ! 玻璃材质

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! 幕墙单元格 Master Script

IF A < 0.10 THEN A = 0.10
IF ZZYZX < 0.10 THEN ZZYZX = 0.10

_v_count = INT(v_divs)
_h_count = INT(h_divs)

IF _v_count < 1 THEN _v_count = 1
IF _h_count < 1 THEN _h_count = 1

_cell_w = A / _v_count
_cell_h = ZZYZX / _h_count

_max_frame_w = _cell_w * 0.90
IF _cell_h * 0.90 < _max_frame_w THEN _max_frame_w = _cell_h * 0.90
IF A * 0.45 < _max_frame_w THEN _max_frame_w = A * 0.45
IF ZZYZX * 0.45 < _max_frame_w THEN _max_frame_w = ZZYZX * 0.45

IF mullion_w < 0.001 THEN mullion_w = 0.001
IF mullion_w > _max_frame_w THEN mullion_w = _max_frame_w

IF mullion_d < 0.001 THEN mullion_d = 0.001
_frame_d = mullion_d
B = _frame_d

IF glass_thk < 0.001 THEN glass_thk = 0.001
IF glass_thk > _frame_d * 0.90 THEN glass_thk = _frame_d * 0.90

_clear_w = MAX(0.001, _cell_w - mullion_w)
_clear_h = MAX(0.001, _cell_h - mullion_w)
_glass_depth = MAX(0.001, glass_thk)
_glass_y = _frame_d / 2 - _glass_depth / 2

_frame_inner_h = MAX(0.001, ZZYZX - 2 * mullion_w)
_frame_inner_w = MAX(0.001, A - 2 * mullion_w)

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl
! 幕墙单元格立面二维符号

_v_count = INT(v_divs)
_h_count = INT(h_divs)

IF _v_count < 1 THEN _v_count = 1
IF _h_count < 1 THEN _h_count = 1

_cell_w = A / _v_count
_cell_h = ZZYZX / _h_count

_max_frame_w = _cell_w * 0.90
IF _cell_h * 0.90 < _max_frame_w THEN _max_frame_w = _cell_h * 0.90
IF A * 0.45 < _max_frame_w THEN _max_frame_w = A * 0.45
IF ZZYZX * 0.45 < _max_frame_w THEN _max_frame_w = ZZYZX * 0.45

_frame_w = mullion_w
IF _frame_w < 0.001 THEN _frame_w = 0.001
IF _frame_w > _max_frame_w THEN _frame_w = _max_frame_w

_clear_w = MAX(0.001, _cell_w - _frame_w)
_clear_h = MAX(0.001, _cell_h - _frame_w)

PEN 1
RECT2 0, 0, A, ZZYZX

PEN 5
FOR i = 0 TO _v_count - 1
    FOR j = 0 TO _h_count - 1
        RECT2 i * _cell_w + _frame_w / 2, j * _cell_h + _frame_w / 2, (i + 1) * _cell_w - _frame_w / 2, (j + 1) * _cell_h - _frame_w / 2
    NEXT j
NEXT i

PEN 1
FOR i = 1 TO _v_count - 1
    LINE2 i * _cell_w, 0, i * _cell_w, ZZYZX
NEXT i

FOR j = 1 TO _h_count - 1
    LINE2 0, j * _cell_h, A, j * _cell_h
NEXT j

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, ZZYZX
HOTSPOT2 A, ZZYZX

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
! 幕墙单元格 3D Script

_v_count = INT(v_divs)
_h_count = INT(h_divs)

IF _v_count < 1 THEN _v_count = 1
IF _h_count < 1 THEN _h_count = 1

_cell_w = A / _v_count
_cell_h = ZZYZX / _h_count

_max_frame_w = _cell_w * 0.90
IF _cell_h * 0.90 < _max_frame_w THEN _max_frame_w = _cell_h * 0.90
IF A * 0.45 < _max_frame_w THEN _max_frame_w = A * 0.45
IF ZZYZX * 0.45 < _max_frame_w THEN _max_frame_w = ZZYZX * 0.45

_frame_w = mullion_w
IF _frame_w < 0.001 THEN _frame_w = 0.001
IF _frame_w > _max_frame_w THEN _frame_w = _max_frame_w

_frame_d = mullion_d
IF _frame_d < 0.001 THEN _frame_d = 0.001

_glass_depth = glass_thk
IF _glass_depth < 0.001 THEN _glass_depth = 0.001
IF _glass_depth > _frame_d * 0.90 THEN _glass_depth = _frame_d * 0.90

_clear_w = MAX(0.001, _cell_w - _frame_w)
_clear_h = MAX(0.001, _cell_h - _frame_w)
_glass_y = _frame_d / 2 - _glass_depth / 2
_frame_inner_w = MAX(0.001, A - 2 * _frame_w)
_frame_inner_h = MAX(0.001, ZZYZX - 2 * _frame_w)

MATERIAL mat_frame

! 底部边框
BLOCK A, _frame_d, _frame_w

! 顶部边框
ADD 0, 0, ZZYZX - _frame_w
BLOCK A, _frame_d, _frame_w
DEL 1

! 左侧边框
ADD 0, 0, _frame_w
BLOCK _frame_w, _frame_d, _frame_inner_h
DEL 1

! 右侧边框
ADD A - _frame_w, 0, _frame_w
BLOCK _frame_w, _frame_d, _frame_inner_h
DEL 1

! 内部竖框
IF _v_count > 1 THEN
    FOR i = 1 TO _v_count - 1
        ADD i * _cell_w - _frame_w / 2, 0, _frame_w
        BLOCK _frame_w, _frame_d, _frame_inner_h
        DEL 1
    NEXT i
ENDIF

! 内部横框
IF _h_count > 1 THEN
    FOR j = 1 TO _h_count - 1
        ADD _frame_w, 0, j * _cell_h - _frame_w / 2
        BLOCK _frame_inner_w, _frame_d, _frame_w
        DEL 1
    NEXT j
ENDIF

MATERIAL mat_glass

! 玻璃面板
FOR i = 0 TO _v_count - 1
    FOR j = 0 TO _h_count - 1
        ADD i * _cell_w + _frame_w / 2, _glass_y, j * _cell_h + _frame_w / 2
        BLOCK _clear_w, _glass_depth, _clear_h
        DEL 1
    NEXT j
NEXT i

END

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Window master script

IF A < 0.20 THEN A = 0.20
IF B < 0.05 THEN B = 0.05
IF ZZYZX < 0.30 THEN ZZYZX = 0.30
IF frame_w < 0.02 THEN frame_w = 0.02
IF glass_thk < 0.003 THEN glass_thk = 0.003
IF glass_thk > 0.025 THEN glass_thk = 0.025
IF sash_w < 0.05 THEN sash_w = 0.05
IF open_angle < 0 THEN open_angle = 0
IF open_angle > 180 THEN open_angle = 180
IF hinge_side < 1 THEN hinge_side = 1
IF hinge_side > 2 THEN hinge_side = 2
hinge_side = ROUND(hinge_side) ! Fixed: 归一化铰链侧，避免整数参数收到非整数值时分支不稳定

_host_wall_thk = WALL_THICKNESS
_host_wall_h = WALL_HEIGHT
_seo_mode = GLOB_SEO_TOOL_MODE

_clear_w = MAX(0.10, A - 2 * frame_w)
_clear_h = MAX(0.10, ZZYZX - 2 * frame_w)
_safe_sash_w = MAX(0.05, MIN(sash_w, MAX(0.05, _clear_w - 0.02)))
_fixed_w = MAX(0.02, _clear_w - _safe_sash_w)
_sash_frame_w = MAX(0.03, MIN(frame_w, _clear_w / 4))
_glass_clear_w = MAX(0.02, _safe_sash_w - 2 * _sash_frame_w)
_glass_clear_h = MAX(0.02, _clear_h - 2 * _sash_frame_w)

_swing_depth = _safe_sash_w * ABS(SIN(open_angle)) + 2 * frame_w
IF open_angle > 0 THEN
    B = MAX(B, _swing_depth) ! Fixed: 扩大宿主参考深度以包含开启扇旋转后的实际包围盒
ENDIF

_opening_depth = frame_w * 2 ! Fixed: 开启扇采用局部框体深度，避免将B重复叠加到旋转包络
_arc_radius = MAX(0.05, _safe_sash_w)

IF hinge_side = 1 THEN
    _hinge_x = -_clear_w / 2 + _sash_frame_w
ELSE
    _hinge_x = _clear_w / 2 - _sash_frame_w
ENDIF

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! H-section column-beam connection master script
! Internal units are meters.

IF A < 0.10 THEN A = 0.10
IF B < 0.10 THEN B = 0.10
IF ZZYZX < 0.10 THEN ZZYZX = 0.10

IF node_height < 0.05 THEN node_height = 0.05
IF node_height > col_length - 0.05 THEN node_height = col_length - 0.05
IF col_length < 0.10 THEN col_length = 0.10
IF beam_length < 0.05 THEN beam_length = 0.05

IF col_hw < 2 * col_tf + 0.002 THEN col_hw = 2 * col_tf + 0.002
IF col_bf < col_tw + 0.002 THEN col_bf = col_tw + 0.002
IF beam_hw < 0.002 THEN beam_hw = 0.002
IF beam_bf < beam_tw + 0.002 THEN beam_bf = beam_tw + 0.002
IF beam_tf < 0.002 THEN beam_tf = 0.002

IF bolt_rows < 1 THEN bolt_rows = 1
IF bolt_cols < 1 THEN bolt_cols = 1
IF bolt_row_pitch < 0.001 THEN bolt_row_pitch = 0.001
IF bolt_col_pitch < 0.001 THEN bolt_col_pitch = 0.001
IF bolt_edge_dist < 0.001 THEN bolt_edge_dist = 0.001
IF bolt_d < 0.001 THEN bolt_d = 0.001

_col_total_d = col_hw
_col_web_clear = col_bf - 2 * col_tf
_beam_total_h = beam_hw + 2 * beam_tf

_bolt_group_h = MAX(0, bolt_rows - 1) * bolt_row_pitch
_bolt_group_w = MAX(0, bolt_cols - 1) * bolt_col_pitch
_plate_min_w = _bolt_group_w + 2 * bolt_edge_dist
_plate_min_h = _bolt_group_h + 2 * bolt_edge_dist

IF conn_plate_w < _plate_min_w THEN conn_plate_w = _plate_min_w
IF conn_plate_h < _plate_min_h THEN conn_plate_h = _plate_min_h

IF conn_side < 0 THEN conn_side = -1
IF conn_side = 0 THEN conn_side = 1

IF bolt_head_d < bolt_d THEN bolt_head_d = bolt_d
IF bolt_head_h < 0.001 THEN bolt_head_h = 0.001
IF stiff_t < 0.001 THEN stiff_t = 0.001
IF stiff_h < 0.002 THEN stiff_h = 0.002
IF stiff_w < 0.002 THEN stiff_w = 0.002

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! H-section column-beam connection plan symbol

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
HOTSPOT2 beam_length, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, node_height

PEN 1
RECT2 0, 0, A, B

IF show_bolts THEN
    FOR _r = 1 TO bolt_rows
        FOR _c = 1 TO bolt_cols
            _bx = beam_length * 0.15 + (_c - (bolt_cols + 1) / 2) * bolt_col_pitch
            _by = B / 2 + (_r - (bolt_rows + 1) / 2) * bolt_row_pitch
            CIRCLE2 _bx, _by, bolt_d / 2
        NEXT _c
    NEXT _r
ENDIF

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! H-section steel column-beam connection
! Local coordinates: X = beam axis, Y = column flange normal, Z = vertical.

TOLER 0.001

GOSUB "DrawColumn"
GOSUB "DrawBeam"
GOSUB "DrawConnectionPlate"
GOSUB "DrawBolts"
GOSUB "DrawStiffeners"

END

"DrawColumn":
    MATERIAL mat_col

    ADD -col_bf / 2, -col_tf / 2, 0
        BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, col_length
    DEL 1

    ADD -col_bf / 2, col_hw / 2 - col_tf / 2, 0
        BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, col_length
    DEL 1

    ADD -col_tw / 2, -col_bf / 2 + col_tf, 0
        BLOCK col_tw, col_bf - 2 * col_tf, col_length
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawBeam":
    MATERIAL mat_beam

    ADD 0, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t + beam_tw / 2), node_height - beam_hw / 2
        BLOCK beam_length, beam_tw, beam_hw
    DEL 1

    ADD 0, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t + beam_tw / 2), node_height - beam_hw / 2 - beam_tf
        BLOCK beam_length, beam_bf, beam_tf
    DEL 1

    ADD 0, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t + beam_tw / 2), node_height + beam_hw / 2
        BLOCK beam_length, beam_bf, beam_tf
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawConnectionPlate":
    MATERIAL mat_plate

    ADD -conn_plate_w / 2, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t / 2), node_height - conn_plate_h / 2
        BLOCK conn_plate_w, conn_plate_t, conn_plate_h
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawBolts":
    IF show_bolts THEN
        MATERIAL mat_bolt

        FOR _r = 1 TO bolt_rows
            FOR _c = 1 TO bolt_cols
                _bolt_x = (_c - (bolt_cols + 1) / 2) * bolt_col_pitch
                _bolt_z = node_height + (_r - (bolt_rows + 1) / 2) * bolt_row_pitch

                ADD _bolt_x, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t + beam_tw / 2), _bolt_z
                    ROTX 90
                    CYLIND beam_tw + conn_plate_t + bolt_head_h, bolt_d / 2
                DEL 2

                ADD _bolt_x, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t + beam_tw / 2), _bolt_z
                    ROTX 90
                    ADDZ -bolt_head_h / 2
                        CYLIND bolt_head_h, bolt_head_d / 2
                    DEL 1
                DEL 2

                IF show_nuts THEN
                    MATERIAL mat_nut
                    ADD _bolt_x, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t + beam_tw / 2), _bolt_z
                        ROTX 90
                        ADDZ bolt_head_h / 2
                            CYLIND bolt_head_h, bolt_head_d / 2
                        DEL 1
                    DEL 2
                ENDIF
            NEXT _c
        NEXT _r
    ENDIF
RETURN

"DrawStiffeners":
    IF has_stiff THEN
        MATERIAL mat_stiff

        ADD -stiff_w / 2, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t), node_height - stiff_h / 2
            ROTX 90
            PRISM_ 3, stiff_t, -stiff_w / 2, 0, 0, stiff_w / 2, 0, 0, 0, stiff_h, 0
        DEL 2

        ADD -stiff_w / 2, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t), node_height + stiff_h / 2
            ROTX 90
            PRISM_ 3, stiff_t, -stiff_w / 2, 0, 0, stiff_w / 2, 0, 0, 0, -stiff_h, 0
        DEL 2
    ENDIF
RETURN

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Pipe elbow master script
! Internal units are meters.

IF pipe_od <= 0 THEN pipe_od = 0.1143
IF pipe_thk <= 0 THEN pipe_thk = 0.0063
IF pipe_thk >= pipe_od / 2 THEN pipe_thk = pipe_od * 0.49
IF bend_radius <= pipe_od / 2 THEN bend_radius = pipe_od

IF bend_angle < 67.5 THEN
    bend_angle = 45
ELSE
    IF bend_angle < 112.5 THEN
        bend_angle = 90
    ELSE
        bend_angle = 135
    ENDIF
ENDIF

_pipe_ro = pipe_od / 2
_pipe_ri = _pipe_ro - pipe_thk
_bend_outer_radius = bend_radius + _pipe_ro
_bend_inner_radius = bend_radius - _pipe_ro
_centerline_end_x = bend_radius * SIN(bend_angle)
_centerline_end_y = bend_radius * (1 - COS(bend_angle))
_envelope_x = bend_radius + _pipe_ro
_envelope_y = bend_radius * (1 - COS(bend_angle)) + _pipe_ro

A = _envelope_x
B = _envelope_y
ZZYZX = pipe_od

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
! Parametric hollow pipe elbow
! Horizontal local XY bend representation.

TOLER 0.002
MATERIAL mat_pipe

! Annular elbow profile:
! outer radius = bend_radius + pipe_ro
! inner radius = bend_radius - pipe_ro
! The inner arc is reversed to preserve the hollow wall contour.
REVOLVE_ 12, bend_angle, mat_pipe, mat_pipe, mat_pipe, 63,
    _bend_outer_radius, 0, 0,
    _bend_outer_radius * COS(bend_angle / 3), _bend_outer_radius * SIN(bend_angle / 3), 0,
    _bend_outer_radius * COS(bend_angle * 2 / 3), _bend_outer_radius * SIN(bend_angle * 2 / 3), 0,
    _bend_outer_radius * COS(bend_angle), _bend_outer_radius * SIN(bend_angle), 0,
    _bend_inner_radius * COS(bend_angle), _bend_inner_radius * SIN(bend_angle), 0,
    _bend_inner_radius * COS(bend_angle * 2 / 3), _bend_inner_radius * SIN(bend_angle * 2 / 3), 0,
    _bend_inner_radius * COS(bend_angle / 3), _bend_inner_radius * SIN(bend_angle / 3), 0,
    _bend_inner_radius, 0, 0,
    _bend_inner_radius, 0, 0,
    _bend_outer_radius, 0, 0,
    _bend_outer_radius, 0, 0,
    _bend_outer_radius, 0, 0

END

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! 圆形餐桌 Master Script

IF A < 0.300 THEN
    A = 0.300
ENDIF

IF ZZYZX < 0.100 THEN
    ZZYZX = 0.100
ENDIF

IF top_thk < 0.005 THEN
    top_thk = 0.005
ENDIF

IF top_thk > ZZYZX - 0.001 THEN
    top_thk = ZZYZX - 0.001
ENDIF

IF leg_d < 0.010 THEN
    leg_d = 0.010
ENDIF

IF leg_d > A THEN
    leg_d = A
ENDIF

_leg_count = INT (leg_count)

IF _leg_count < 3 THEN
    _leg_count = 3
ENDIF

IF _leg_count > 12 THEN
    _leg_count = 12
ENDIF

PARAMETERS B = A
PARAMETERS leg_count = _leg_count

HIDEPARAMETER "B"

_table_r = A / 2
_leg_h = MAX (0.001, ZZYZX - top_thk)
_leg_inset = MAX (0.020, MIN (0.100, A * 0.075))
_leg_center_r = MAX (0, _table_r - leg_d / 2 - _leg_inset)
_leg_step = 360 / _leg_count

_seo_mode = GLOB_SEO_TOOL_MODE
_wall_thickness = WALL_THICKNESS
_wall_height = WALL_HEIGHT

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! 圆形餐桌 3D Script

PEN 1
RESOL 48

MATERIAL mat_top
ADDZ ZZYZX - top_thk
CYLIND top_thk, A / 2
DEL 1

MATERIAL mat_leg

FOR i = 0 TO leg_count - 1
    _angle = i * 360 / leg_count
    _leg_x = _leg_center_r * COS (_angle)
    _leg_y = _leg_center_r * SIN (_angle)

    ADDX _leg_x
    ADDY _leg_y
    CYLIND _leg_h, leg_d / 2
    DEL 2
NEXT i

END

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! 圆形餐桌 2D Script

PEN 1
CIRCLE2 0, 0, A / 2
LINE2 -A / 2, 0, A / 2, 0
LINE2 0, -A / 2, 0, A / 2

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, A / 2
HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, 0

FOR i = 0 TO leg_count - 1
    _angle = i * 360 / leg_count
    _leg_x = _leg_center_r * COS (_angle)
    _leg_y = _leg_center_r * SIN (_angle)
    CIRCLE2 _leg_x, _leg_y, leg_d / 2
NEXT i

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! H-section steel column-beam connection
! Local coordinates: X = beam axis, Y = column flange normal, Z = vertical.

TOLER 0.001

GOSUB "DrawColumn"
GOSUB "DrawBeam"
GOSUB "DrawConnectionPlate"
GOSUB "DrawBolts"
GOSUB "DrawStiffeners"

END

"DrawColumn":
    MATERIAL mat_col

    ADD -col_bf / 2, -col_tf / 2, 0
        BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, col_length
    DEL 1

    ADD -col_bf / 2, col_hw / 2 - col_tf / 2, 0
        BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, col_length
    DEL 1

    ADD -col_tw / 2, -col_bf / 2 + col_tf, 0
        BLOCK col_tw, col_bf - 2 * col_tf, col_length
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawBeam":
    MATERIAL mat_beam

    ADD 0, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t + beam_tw / 2), node_height - beam_hw / 2
        BLOCK beam_length, beam_tw, beam_hw
    DEL 1

    ADD 0, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t + beam_tw / 2), node_height - beam_hw / 2 - beam_tf
        BLOCK beam_length, beam_bf, beam_tf
    DEL 1

    ADD 0, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t + beam_tw / 2), node_height + beam_hw / 2
        BLOCK beam_length, beam_bf, beam_tf
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawConnectionPlate":
    MATERIAL mat_plate

    ADD -conn_plate_w / 2, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t / 2), node_height - conn_plate_h / 2
        BLOCK conn_plate_w, conn_plate_t, conn_plate_h
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawBolts":
    IF show_bolts THEN
        MATERIAL mat_bolt

        ! Fixed: initialize local loop indices before bolt array traversal
        _r = 0
        _c = 0
        FOR _r = 1 TO bolt_rows
            FOR _c = 1 TO bolt_cols
                _bolt_x = (_c - (bolt_cols + 1) / 2) * bolt_col_pitch
                _bolt_z = node_height + (_r - (bolt_rows + 1) / 2) * bolt_row_pitch

                ADD _bolt_x, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t + beam_tw / 2), _bolt_z
                    ROTX 90
                    CYLIND beam_tw + conn_plate_t + bolt_head_h, bolt_d / 2
                DEL 2

                ADD _bolt_x, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t + beam_tw / 2), _bolt_z
                    ROTX 90
                    ADDZ -bolt_head_h / 2
                        CYLIND bolt_head_h, bolt_head_d / 2
                    DEL 1
                DEL 2

                IF show_nuts THEN
                    MATERIAL mat_nut
                    ADD _bolt_x, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t + beam_tw / 2), _bolt_z
                        ROTX 90
                        ADDZ bolt_head_h / 2
                            CYLIND bolt_head_h, bolt_head_d / 2
                        DEL 1
                    DEL 2
                ENDIF
            NEXT _c
        NEXT _r
    ENDIF
RETURN

"DrawStiffeners":
    IF has_stiff THEN
        MATERIAL mat_stiff

        ADD -stiff_w / 2, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t), node_height - stiff_h / 2
            ROTX 90
            PRISM_ 3, stiff_t, -stiff_w / 2, 0, 0, stiff_w / 2, 0, 0, 0, stiff_h, 0
        DEL 2

        ADD -stiff_w / 2, conn_side * (col_hw / 2 + conn_plate_t), node_height + stiff_h / 2
            ROTX 90
            PRISM_ 3, stiff_t, -stiff_w / 2, 0, 0, stiff_w / 2, 0, 0, 0, -stiff_h, 0
        DEL 2
    ENDIF
RETURN

! 厨房吊柜 3D Script
! 原点位于柜体左前下角，X为宽度，Y为深度，Z为高度

RESOL 12

! 柜体侧板
MATERIAL mat_body
BLOCK panel_thk, B, ZZYZX

ADDX A - panel_thk
BLOCK panel_thk, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! 顶板
ADD panel_thk, 0, ZZYZX - panel_thk
BLOCK _inner_w, B, panel_thk
DEL 1

! 底板
ADD panel_thk, 0, 0
BLOCK _inner_w, B, panel_thk
DEL 1

! 背板
MATERIAL mat_back
ADD 0, B - back_thk, 0
BLOCK A, back_thk, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! 内部层板
MATERIAL mat_body
FOR i = 1 TO n_shelves
    _shelf_z = panel_thk + i * (_shelf_space + shelf_thk)
    ADD panel_thk, 0, _shelf_z
    BLOCK _inner_w, _inner_d, shelf_thk
    DEL 1
NEXT i

! 柜门
IF has_door THEN
    MATERIAL mat_door
    ADD _door_x, _door_y, 0
    BLOCK _door_w, door_thk, ZZYZX
    DEL 1

    ! 简化铰链标识，位于对应铰链侧
    MATERIAL mat_handle
    IF hinge_side = 1 THEN
        ADD door_gap, -door_thk - 0.001, 0.120
        BLOCK 0.018, 0.012, 0.060
        DEL 1

        ADD door_gap, -door_thk - 0.001, ZZYZX - 0.180
        BLOCK 0.018, 0.012, 0.060
        DEL 1
    ELSE
        ADD A - door_gap - 0.018, -door_thk - 0.001, 0.120
        BLOCK 0.018, 0.012, 0.060
        DEL 1

        ADD A - door_gap - 0.018, -door_thk - 0.001, ZZYZX - 0.180
        BLOCK 0.018, 0.012, 0.060
        DEL 1
    ENDIF

    ! 简化把手
    IF show_handle THEN
        ADD _handle_x, -door_thk - 0.014, ZZYZX / 2 - 0.050
        BLOCK 0.020, 0.014, 0.100
        DEL 1
    ENDIF
ENDIF

END

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl
! 厨房吊柜 2D Script

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
HOTSPOT2 0, ZZYZX

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

! 柜体前缘
PEN 1
LINE2 0, 0, A, 0

IF has_door THEN
    ! 门缝线
    LINE2 door_gap, -door_gap, A - door_gap, -door_gap

    ! 左开/右开开启方向符号
    IF hinge_side = 1 THEN
        LINE2 door_gap, 0, door_gap + _door_w, 0
        ARC2 door_gap, 0, _door_w, 0, 90
    ELSE
        LINE2 A - door_gap, 0, A - door_gap - _door_w, 0
        ARC2 A - door_gap, 0, _door_w, 90, 180
    ENDIF

    IF show_handle THEN
        LINE2 _handle_x, -door_thk - 0.010, _handle_x, -door_thk - 0.050
    ENDIF
ELSE
    ! 开放柜口前缘与层板提示线
    LINE2 0, 0, A, 0
    FOR i = 1 TO n_shelves
        _shelf_z = panel_thk + i * (_shelf_space + shelf_thk)
        LINE2 panel_thk, _shelf_z, A - panel_thk, _shelf_z
    NEXT i
ENDIF

RESOL 12
END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.100 ! Plan envelope width
Length B = 0.100 ! Plan envelope depth
Length ZZYZX = 0.900 ! Total height
Integer seg_count = 3 ! Number of turned body segments
Length base_d = 0.100 ! Base diameter
Length top_d = 0.075 ! Top diameter
Material mat_body = 0 ! Body material
RealNum turning_relief = 0.180 ! Turning relief ratio
Boolean show_2d_detail = 0 ! Show 2D detail

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Turning railing post master script

IF ZZYZX < 0.05 THEN ZZYZX = 0.05
IF base_d < 0.02 THEN base_d = 0.02
IF top_d < 0.02 THEN top_d = 0.02
IF turning_relief < 0 THEN turning_relief = 0
IF turning_relief > 0.6 THEN turning_relief = 0.6

safe_h = MAX(ZZYZX, 0.05)
safe_seg_count = MAX(2, MIN(INT(seg_count), 24))
seg_h = safe_h / safe_seg_count

base_r = base_d / 2
top_r = top_d / 2

transition_h = seg_h * 0.1
IF transition_h > safe_h * 0.03 THEN transition_h = safe_h * 0.03

effective_A = MAX(A, base_d)
effective_B = MAX(B, base_d)
A = effective_A
B = effective_B

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! Turning railing post 2D plan symbol

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

RECT2 -A / 2, -B / 2, A / 2, B / 2
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

IF show_2d_detail THEN
    CIRCLE2 0, 0, base_d / 2
    CIRCLE2 0, 0, top_d / 2
    LINE2 -A / 2, 0, A / 2, 0
    LINE2 0, -B / 2, 0, B / 2
ENDIF

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Turning railing post 3D script

PEN 1
MATERIAL mat_body
TOLER 0.001

PUT 0, 0, 0
PUT base_r, 0, 0

FOR seg_index = 0 TO safe_seg_count - 1
    _t = (seg_index + 0.1) / safe_seg_count
    _base_interp = base_r + (top_r - base_r) * _t
    _relief_factor = 1 - ABS(2 * _t - 1)
    _profile_r = _base_interp * (1 + turning_relief * _relief_factor * (1 - 0.25 * MOD(seg_index, 2)))
    _profile_z = seg_index * seg_h + transition_h
    PUT _profile_r, _profile_z, 0

    _t = (seg_index + 0.5) / safe_seg_count
    _base_interp = base_r + (top_r - base_r) * _t
    _relief_factor = 1 - ABS(2 * _t - 1)
    _profile_r = _base_interp * (1 + turning_relief * _relief_factor * (1 - 0.25 * MOD(seg_index, 2)))
    _profile_z = seg_index * seg_h + seg_h * 0.5
    PUT _profile_r, _profile_z, 0

    _t = (seg_index + 0.9) / safe_seg_count
    _base_interp = base_r + (top_r - base_r) * _t
    _relief_factor = 1 - ABS(2 * _t - 1)
    _profile_r = _base_interp * (1 + turning_relief * _relief_factor * (1 - 0.25 * MOD(seg_index, 2)))
    _profile_z = (seg_index + 1) * seg_h - transition_h
    PUT _profile_r, _profile_z, 0
NEXT seg_index

PUT top_r, safe_h, 0
PUT 0, safe_h, 0

ROTX -90
REVOLVE_ NSP / 3, 360, mat_body, mat_body, mat_body, 63, GET(NSP)
DEL 1

HOTSPOT 0, 0, 0, 1, 101
HOTSPOT 0, 0, safe_h, 1, 102
HOTSPOT base_r, 0, 0, 1, 103
HOTSPOT top_r, 0, safe_h, 1, 104

END

! Wall handrail bracket master script
! Internal unit: meters

IF A < 0.060 THEN A = 0.060
IF B < 0.100 THEN B = 0.100
IF arm_length < 0.020 THEN arm_length = 0.020
IF bracket_thk < 0.003 THEN bracket_thk = 0.003
IF rail_d < 0.020 THEN rail_d = 0.020

_safe_bolt_count = INT(bolt_count)
IF _safe_bolt_count < 1 THEN _safe_bolt_count = 1
IF _safe_bolt_count > 6 THEN _safe_bolt_count = 6

_bolt_edge = MAX(B * 0.18, rail_d * 0.8)
_bolt_edge = MIN(_bolt_edge, B * 0.45)

IF _safe_bolt_count > 1 THEN
    _bolt_spacing = (B - 2 * _bolt_edge) / (_safe_bolt_count - 1)
ELSE
    _bolt_spacing = 0
ENDIF

_bolt_d = bracket_thk * 1.5
_bolt_d = MAX(_bolt_d, 0.006)
_bolt_d = MIN(_bolt_d, 0.018)

_rail_clearance = 0.002
_saddle_r = rail_d / 2 + _rail_clearance

_arm_width = MIN(A, MAX(0.030, rail_d * 1.5))
_rail_stub_len = MAX(arm_length * 0.8, rail_d * 3)
_bolt_head_h = bracket_thk * 0.5

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Wall handrail bracket 3D script
! Object type: railing_accessory_wall_handrail_bracket

TOLER 0.001
PEN 1

! Wall plate
MATERIAL mat_bracket
BLOCK bracket_thk, A, B

! Cantilever arm
MATERIAL mat_bracket
ADD 0, (A - _arm_width) / 2, B / 2 - bracket_thk / 2
    BLOCK arm_length, _arm_width, bracket_thk
DEL 1

! Rail saddle support
MATERIAL mat_bracket
ADD 0, A / 2, B / 2 + bracket_thk
    PRISM_ 6, bracket_thk,
        arm_length - bracket_thk, -_saddle_r, 0,
        arm_length, -_saddle_r, 0,
        arm_length + bracket_thk, -_saddle_r * 0.55, 0,
        arm_length + bracket_thk, _saddle_r * 0.55, 0,
        arm_length, _saddle_r, 0,
        arm_length - bracket_thk, _saddle_r, 0
DEL 1

! Optional short circular handrail segment
IF show_rail_stub THEN
    MATERIAL mat_rail
    ADD arm_length, A / 2 + _rail_stub_len / 2, B / 2 + bracket_thk + bracket_thk + _rail_clearance + rail_d / 2
        ROTX -90
        CYLIND _rail_stub_len, rail_d / 2
    DEL 2
ENDIF

! Wall fixing bolts and washers
IF show_bolts THEN
    MATERIAL mat_bolt
    FOR i = 1 TO _safe_bolt_count
        IF _safe_bolt_count > 1 THEN
            _bolt_z = _bolt_edge + (i - 1) * _bolt_spacing
        ELSE
            _bolt_z = B / 2
        ENDIF

        ADD -_bolt_head_h, A / 2, _bolt_z
            ROTY 90
            CYLIND bracket_thk + _bolt_head_h, _bolt_d / 2
        DEL 2

        ADD -_bolt_head_h, A / 2, _bolt_z
            ROTY 90
            CYLIND _bolt_head_h, _bolt_d * 0.7
        DEL 2
    NEXT i
ENDIF

END

_x2 = A

_z2 = _upper_z
_rod_len = A

        _x1 = _x_left

        _z1 = _upper_z

    GOSUB "DrawRod"
NEXT i

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Turning railing post 3D script

PEN 1
MATERIAL mat_body
TOLER 0.001

PUT 0, 0, 0
PUT base_r, 0, 0

FOR seg_index = 0 TO safe_seg_count - 1
    _t = (seg_index + 0.1) / safe_seg_count
    _base_interp = base_r + (top_r - base_r) * _t
    _relief_factor = 1 - ABS(2 * _t - 1)
    _profile_r = _base_interp * (1 + turning_relief * _relief_factor * (1 - 0.25 * MOD(seg_index, 2)))
    _profile_z = seg_index * seg_h + transition_h
    PUT _profile_r, _profile_z, 0

    _t = (seg_index + 0.5) / safe_seg_count
    _base_interp = base_r + (top_r - base_r) * _t
    _relief_factor = 1 - ABS(2 * _t - 1)
    _profile_r = _base_interp * (1 + turning_relief * _relief_factor * (1 - 0.25 * MOD(seg_index, 2)))
    _profile_z = seg_index * seg_h + seg_h * 0.5
    PUT _profile_r, _profile_z, 0

    _t = (seg_index + 0.9) / safe_seg_count
    _base_interp = base_r + (top_r - base_r) * _t
    _relief_factor = 1 - ABS(2 * _t - 1)
    _profile_r = _base_interp * (1 + turning_relief * _relief_factor * (1 - 0.25 * MOD(seg_index, 2)))
    _profile_z = (seg_index + 1) * seg_h - transition_h
    PUT _profile_r, _profile_z, 0
NEXT seg_index

PUT top_r, safe_h, 0
PUT 0, safe_h, 0

! Fixed: 使用局部Z轴轮廓直接旋转，避免ROTX导致REVOLVE轮廓方向异常
REVOLVE_ NSP / 3, 360, mat_body, mat_body, mat_body, 63, GET(NSP)

HOTSPOT 0, 0, 0, 1, 101
HOTSPOT 0, 0, safe_h, 1, 102
HOTSPOT base_r, 0, 0, 1, 103
HOTSPOT top_r, 0, safe_h, 1, 104

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 1.80 ! Overall stair diameter
Length B = 2.88 ! Total stair height, synchronized from stair_steps * riser_h
Length ZZYZX = 2.88 ! Object height
Integer stair_steps = 16 ! Total number of steps
Length riser_h = 0.180 ! Rise per step
Angle total_angle = 360 ! Total rotation angle
Length tread_w = 0.750 ! Radial tread width
Length pole_r = 0.100 ! Center pole radius
Length tread_thk = 0.050 ! Tread thickness
Material mat_tread = 0 ! Tread material
Material mat_pole = 0 ! Center pole material
Boolean show_pole = 1 ! Show center pole
Boolean show_2d_steps = 1 ! Show individual steps in 2D

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF stair_steps < 1 THEN stair_steps = 1
IF stair_steps > 200 THEN stair_steps = 200
stair_steps = INT (stair_steps)

IF riser_h < 0.05 THEN riser_h = 0.05
IF tread_thk < 0.005 THEN tread_thk = 0.005
IF pole_r < 0.01 THEN pole_r = 0.01
IF A < 0.20 THEN A = 0.20

IF pole_r >= A / 2 THEN pole_r = A / 2 - 0.01
IF tread_w < 0.15 THEN tread_w = 0.15

_step_angle = total_angle / stair_steps
_total_h = stair_steps * riser_h
_outer_r = A / 2
_inner_r = pole_r
_effective_tread_w = _outer_r - _inner_r

IF tread_w > _effective_tread_w THEN tread_w = _effective_tread_w
IF tread_w < 0.01 THEN tread_w = 0.01

_tread_outer_r = _inner_r + tread_w
_tangential_half_width = _tread_outer_r * TAN (ABS (_step_angle) / 2)

B = _total_h
ZZYZX = _total_h

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
PEN 1

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

HOTSPOT2 _outer_r, 0
HOTSPOT2 _tread_outer_r, 0
HOTSPOT2 _tread_outer_r * COS (total_angle), _tread_outer_r * SIN (total_angle)

CIRCLE2 0, 0, pole_r

IF show_2d_steps THEN
    _step_angle_2d = total_angle / stair_steps
    FOR i = 1 TO stair_steps
        _angle_2d = (i - 1) * _step_angle_2d
        LINE2 pole_r * COS (_angle_2d), pole_r * SIN (_angle_2d), _tread_outer_r * COS (_angle_2d), _tread_outer_r * SIN (_angle_2d)
    NEXT i
ENDIF

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
TOLER 0.001

_total_h_3d = stair_steps * riser_h
_outer_r_3d = A / 2
_inner_r_3d = pole_r
_effective_tread_w_3d = _outer_r_3d - _inner_r_3d

IF _effective_tread_w_3d < 0.01 THEN _effective_tread_w_3d = 0.01
IF tread_w < _effective_tread_w_3d THEN
    _tread_outer_r_3d = _inner_r_3d + tread_w
ELSE
    _tread_outer_r_3d = _outer_r_3d
ENDIF

_step_angle_3d = total_angle / stair_steps
_half_angle_3d = ABS (_step_angle_3d) / 2
_inner_x_1 = _inner_r_3d * COS (-_half_angle_3d)
_inner_y_1 = _inner_r_3d * SIN (-_half_angle_3d)
_inner_x_2 = _inner_r_3d * COS (_half_angle_3d)
_inner_y_2 = _inner_r_3d * SIN (_half_angle_3d)
_outer_x_2 = _tread_outer_r_3d * COS (_half_angle_3d)
_outer_y_2 = _tread_outer_r_3d * SIN (_half_angle_3d)
_outer_x_1 = _tread_outer_r_3d * COS (-_half_angle_3d)
_outer_y_1 = _tread_outer_r_3d * SIN (-_half_angle_3d)

IF show_pole THEN
    MATERIAL mat_pole
    CYLIND _total_h_3d, pole_r
ENDIF

MATERIAL mat_tread

FOR i = 1 TO stair_steps
    ADDZ (i - 1) * riser_h
    ROTZ (i - 1) * _step_angle_3d
        PRISM_ 4, tread_thk,
            _inner_x_1, _inner_y_1, 1,
            _inner_x_2, _inner_y_2, 1,
            _outer_x_2, _outer_y_2, 1,
            _outer_x_1, _outer_y_1, 1
    DEL 2
NEXT i

END

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl

IF stair_steps > 200 THEN stair_steps = 200
stair_steps = INT (stair_steps)

IF riser_h < 0.05 THEN riser_h = 0.05
IF tread_w < 0.15 THEN tread_w = 0.15
IF pole_r < 0.01 THEN pole_r = 0.01
IF tread_thk < 0.005 THEN tread_thk = 0.005
IF A < 0.20 THEN A = 0.20

IF pole_r >= A / 2 THEN pole_r = A / 2 - 0.01
IF tread_w > A / 2 - pole_r THEN tread_w = A / 2 - pole_r

B = stair_steps * riser_h
ZZYZX = stair_steps * riser_h

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 1.80 ! Bottom width
Length B = 1.20 ! Bottom depth
Length ZZYZX = 0.75 ! Ridge height
Length glass_thk = 0.012 ! Glass panel thickness
Material mat_glass = 0 ! Glass material
Length frame_width = 0.060 ! Frame visible width
Material mat_frame = 0 ! Frame material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Parameter validation and derived dimensions

IF A < 0.20 THEN A = 0.20
IF B < 0.20 THEN B = 0.20
IF ZZYZX < 0.05 THEN ZZYZX = 0.05
IF glass_thk < 0.004 THEN glass_thk = 0.004
IF glass_thk > 0.050 THEN glass_thk = 0.050
IF frame_width < 0.020 THEN frame_width = 0.020
IF frame_width > A / 2 THEN frame_width = A / 2
IF frame_width > B / 2 THEN frame_width = B / 2

_halfA = A / 2
_halfB = B / 2
_minHeight = MAX(glass_thk * 2, 0.05)
_modelH = MAX(ZZYZX, _minHeight)

_slopeX = SQR(_halfA * _halfA + _modelH * _modelH)
_slopeY = SQR(_halfB * _halfB + _modelH * _modelH)
_slopeNormalX = SQR(_modelH * _modelH + _halfA * _halfA)
_slopeNormalY = SQR(_modelH * _modelH + _halfB * _modelH)
_glassOffset = glass_thk / 2
_frameDepth = glass_thk + frame_width

_slopeAngleX = ATN(_halfA / _modelH)
_slopeAngleY = ATN(_halfB / _modelH)

_cornerHorizontal = SQR(_halfA * _halfA + _halfB * _halfB)
_cornerLen = SQR(_cornerHorizontal * _cornerHorizontal + _modelH * _modelH)
_cornerTilt = ATN(_cornerHorizontal / _modelH)
_cornerAzimuth = ATN(_halfB / _halfA)

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! Parametric plan symbol

PEN 1

HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, -B / 2
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, -B / 2
HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, B / 2
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, B / 2
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, 0, 1, ZZYZX, 1

LINE2 -A / 2, -B / 2, A / 2, -B / 2
LINE2 A / 2, -B / 2, A / 2, B / 2
LINE2 A / 2, B / 2, -A / 2, B / 2
LINE2 -A / 2, B / 2, -A / 2, -B / 2

LINE2 A / 2, -B / 2, 0, 0
LINE2 A / 2, B / 2, 0, 0

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Parametric pyramid skylight
! Bottom rectangle centered at the local origin

TOLER 0.001
PEN 1

! South glass panel
MATERIAL mat_glass
ADD 0, -_halfB, 0
ROTX _slopeAngleY
PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, -_halfA, 0, 0, _halfA, 0, 0, 0, _slopeY, 0
DEL 2

! North glass panel
MATERIAL mat_glass
ADD 0, _halfB, 0
ROTX -_slopeAngleY
PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, -_halfA, 0, 0, _halfA, 0, 0, 0, _slopeY, 0
DEL 2

! East glass panel
MATERIAL mat_glass
ADD _halfA, 0, 0
ROTZ -90
ROTX _slopeAngleX
PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, -_halfB, 0, 0, _halfB, 0, 0, 0, _slopeX, 0
DEL 3

! West glass panel
MATERIAL mat_glass
ADD -_halfA, 0, 0
ROTZ 90
ROTX _slopeAngleX
PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, -_halfB, 0, 0, _halfB, 0, 0, 0, _slopeX, 0
DEL 3

! Bottom perimeter frame
MATERIAL mat_frame

ADD 0, -_halfB, 0
BLOCK A + frame_width * 2, frame_width, frame_width
DEL 1

ADD 0, _halfB - frame_width, 0
BLOCK A + frame_width * 2, frame_width, frame_width
DEL 1

ADD -_halfA, -_halfB + frame_width, 0
BLOCK frame_width, B - frame_width * 2, frame_width
DEL 1

ADD _halfA - frame_width, -_halfB + frame_width, 0
BLOCK frame_width, B - frame_width * 2, frame_width
DEL 1

! South-east corner frame
ADD _halfA, -_halfB, 0
ROTY _cornerTilt
ROTZ 180 - _cornerAzimuth
ADD 0, 0, -_cornerLen / 2
BLOCK frame_width, _frameDepth, _cornerLen
DEL 3

! North-east corner frame
ADD _halfA, _halfB, 0
ROTY _cornerTilt
ROTZ 180 + _cornerAzimuth
ADD 0, 0, -_cornerLen / 2
BLOCK frame_width, _frameDepth, _cornerLen
DEL 3

! North-west corner frame
ADD -_halfA, _halfB, 0
ROTY _cornerTilt
ROTZ -_cornerAzimuth
ADD 0, 0, -_cornerLen / 2
BLOCK frame_width, _frameDepth, _cornerLen
DEL 3

! South-west corner frame
ADD -_halfA, -_halfB, 0
ROTY _cornerTilt
ROTZ _cornerAzimuth
ADD 0, 0, -_cornerLen / 2
BLOCK frame_width, _frameDepth, _cornerLen
DEL 3

! Top junction node
MATERIAL mat_frame
ADD 0, 0, _modelH
SPHERE frame_width * 1.25
DEL 1

END

ADD 0, -_halfB, 0
BLOCK A + frame_width * 2, frame_width, frame_width
DEL 1

ADD 0, _halfB - frame_width, 0
BLOCK A + frame_width * 2, frame_width, frame_width
DEL 1

ADD -_halfA, -_halfB + frame_width, 0
BLOCK frame_width, B - frame_width * 2, frame_width
DEL 1

ADD _halfA - frame_width, -_halfB + frame_width, 0
BLOCK frame_width, B - frame_width * 2, frame_width
DEL 1

! South-east corner frame
ADD _halfA, -_halfB, 0
ROTY _cornerTilt
ROTZ 180 - _cornerAzimuth
ADD 0, 0, -_cornerLen / 2
BLOCK frame_width, _frameDepth, _cornerLen
! Fixed: 角部框架包含3次旋转/平移变换，必须完整弹出4层变换栈
DEL 4

! North-east corner frame
ADD _halfA, _halfB, 0
ROTY _cornerTilt
ROTZ 180 + _cornerAzimuth
ADD 0, 0, -_cornerLen / 2
BLOCK frame_width, _frameDepth, _cornerLen
! Fixed: 修正角部框架变换栈未配平，避免后续几何位置累积偏移
DEL 4

! North-west corner frame
ADD -_halfA, _halfB, 0
ROTY _cornerTilt
ROTZ -_cornerAzimuth
ADD 0, 0, -_cornerLen / 2
BLOCK frame_width, _frameDepth, _cornerLen
! Fixed: 修正角部框架变换栈未配平，避免包围盒异常扩大
DEL 4

! South-west corner frame
ADD -_halfA, -_halfB, 0
ROTY _cornerTilt
ROTZ _cornerAzimuth
ADD 0, 0, -_cornerLen / 2
BLOCK frame_width, _frameDepth, _cornerLen
! Fixed: 修正角部框架变换栈未配平，确保脚本结束时变换归零
DEL 4

! Top junction node
MATERIAL mat_frame
ADD 0, 0, _modelH
SPHERE frame_width * 1.25
DEL 1

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 1.20 ! 安装面宽度
Length B = 0.30 ! 对象包络进深
Length ZZYZX = 2.40 ! 安装面高度
Integer blade_count = 8 ! 百叶叶片数量
Angle blade_angle = 30 ! 叶片倾斜角度
Length blade_depth = 0.30 ! 叶片进深
Material mat_blade = 0 ! 叶片及侧导轨材质

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! 遮阳百叶板阵列参数校验与派生尺寸

IF A < 0.10 THEN A = 0.10
IF ZZYZX < 0.10 THEN ZZYZX = 0.10
IF blade_depth < 0.02 THEN blade_depth = 0.02
IF blade_count < 1 THEN blade_count = 1

blade_count = INT (blade_count)
IF blade_count < 1 THEN blade_count = 1

IF blade_angle < -80 THEN blade_angle = -80
IF blade_angle > 80 THEN blade_angle = 80

! 保持标准包络深度与叶片进深一致
B = blade_depth

! 叶片厚度限制在20至40毫米之间
_blade_thickness = blade_depth / 12
IF _blade_thickness < 0.02 THEN _blade_thickness = 0.02
IF _blade_thickness > 0.04 THEN _blade_thickness = 0.04

_safe_blade_count = MAX (1, INT (blade_count))
_blade_spacing = ZZYZX / (_safe_blade_count + 1)
_first_blade_z = _blade_spacing

_side_rail_width = _blade_thickness * 2
_side_rail_depth = blade_depth
_effective_angle = blade_angle

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl
! 遮阳百叶板阵列平面投影

PEN 1

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! 遮阳百叶板阵列
! 安装面位于X-Z平面，Y为叶片进深方向

PEN 1
MATERIAL mat_blade
TOLER 0.001

! 左侧竖向安装导轨
ADD 0, -_side_rail_depth / 2, 0
BLOCK _side_rail_width, _side_rail_depth, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! 右侧竖向安装导轨
ADD A - _side_rail_width, -_side_rail_depth / 2, 0
BLOCK _side_rail_width, _side_rail_depth, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! 按高度均匀排列水平百叶叶片
FOR i = 1 TO _safe_blade_count
    ADDZ i * _blade_spacing
    ROTX _effective_angle
    ADD 0, -blade_depth / 2, -_blade_thickness / 2
    BLOCK A, blade_depth, _blade_thickness
    DEL 3
NEXT i

END

VALUES "A" RANGE [0.10, 10.00]
VALUES "B" RANGE [0.02, 5.00]

VALUES "blade_angle" RANGE [-80, 80]
VALUES "blade_depth" RANGE [0.02, 2.00]
